## Summary
Build a severity-scored action queue that surfaces admin tasks (review needed, pipeline failures, coverage gaps) ranked by urgency, with dismiss and drill-down actions.

## User story
As an admin, I want to see a prioritized list of tasks requiring my attention, so that I can address the most critical issues first without manually checking every subsystem.

## Why this matters
Without a centralized action queue, admins must check multiple pages to find issues. High-severity items (pipeline failures blocking student content, FERPA-sensitive events) could go unnoticed for hours or days, degrading the student experience or creating compliance risk.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Action queue displays tasks sorted by severity (critical > high > medium > low)
- [ ] Each action item shows: title, description, severity badge, created timestamp, source system
- [ ] Severity scores: critical (pipeline failure), high (coverage gap), medium (review needed), low (informational)
- [ ] Admin can dismiss an action (marks as resolved, does not delete)
- [ ] Action queue is scoped to admin's institution_id
- [ ] Empty state shown when no pending actions exist
- [ ] Actions link to relevant detail page (e.g., dead letter queue, assessment review)

## Schema changes
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.admin_actions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.institutions(id),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low')),
  source_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'pipeline', 'coverage', 'review', 'system'
  source_id UUID, -- optional FK to the source record
  link_url TEXT, -- relative URL to detail page
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'dismissed', 'resolved')),
  dismissed_by UUID REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
  dismissed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.admin_actions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage actions for own institution"
  ON public.admin_actions FOR ALL
  USING (institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()));

CREATE INDEX idx_admin_actions_severity ON public.admin_actions (institution_id, status, severity);
```

## API contract
```
GET /app/api/admin/actions?status=pending
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response 200: {
  data: {
    actions: Array<{
      id: string, title: string, description: string,
      severity: 'critical' | 'high' | 'medium' | 'low',
      source_type: string, link_url: string | null,
      created_at: string
    }>
  },
  error: null
}

POST /app/api/admin/actions/[id]/dismiss
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response 200: { data: { dismissed: true }, error: null }
Response 404: { data: null, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: string } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/admin/repositories/ActionQueueRepository.ts
import { createServerClient, Row } from '@journey/db/client';

type AdminAction = Row<'admin_actions'>;

export class ActionQueueRepository {
  async getPendingActions(): Promise<AdminAction[]> {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('admin_actions')
      .select('*')
      .eq('status', 'pending')
      .order('severity', { ascending: true }) // critical first
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
    if (error) throw error;
    return data;
  }

  async dismissAction(actionId: string): Promise<void> {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('admin_actions')
      .update({ status: 'dismissed', dismissed_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', actionId);
    if (error) throw error;
  }
}

// app/(admin)/queue/page.tsx — < 30 lines
import { ActionQueue } from '@/features/admin/components/ActionQueue';
export default function QueuePage() {
  return <ActionQueue />;
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E02/E02-S05.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('GET /api/admin/actions returns pending actions', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/actions?status=pending');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const body = await res.json();
  expect(body.data).toHaveProperty('actions');
  expect(Array.isArray(body.data.actions)).toBe(true);
});

test('POST /api/admin/actions/[id]/dismiss marks action as dismissed', async ({ request }) => {
  // First create a test action, then dismiss it
  const listRes = await request.get('/api/admin/actions?status=pending');
  const { data } = await listRes.json();
  if (data.actions.length > 0) {
    const actionId = data.actions[0].id;
    const res = await request.post(`/api/admin/actions/${actionId}/dismiss`);
    expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
    const body = await res.json();
    expect(body.data.dismissed).toBe(true);
  }
});

test('POST /api/admin/actions/[id]/dismiss returns 404 for invalid id', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post('/api/admin/actions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/dismiss');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(404);
});

test('GET /api/admin/actions returns 401 when unauthenticated', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/actions');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
});

// tests/E02/E02-S05.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Action queue page renders', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/queue');
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /action/i })).toBeVisible();
});

test('Action queue shows empty state when no actions', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/queue');
  await expect(page.getByText(/no.*action|all.*clear/i)).toBeVisible();
});
```
